criteria.test: FE-A1.3-W02-AC01 critical: model access cannot acquire invented previews basis or authority edits
criteria.observation: Unknown previews, fabricated basis, protected identity/authority changes, invalid native types, partial JSON, prohibited tools and substituted models fail the production core/adapter boundaries.

criteria.test: FE-A1.3-W02-AC02 critical: actual unavailable readiness preserves a draft through a new browser document
criteria.observation: A real production HTTP/PostgreSQL service configured without an eligible model shows its actual readiness failure, prevents a turn, and restores the exact unsent question after a confirmed new-document reload. Shared-state browser checks execute sequentially.

criteria.test: FE-A1.3-W02-AC03 critical: stale deployment and another role certificate cannot borrow eligibility
criteria.observation: A changed deployed proposal core is unavailable before provider access; another role certificate, missing owning provider/context and exact Project read failures cannot borrow eligibility or reveal restricted descriptors.

boundary: Actual managed QA question/follow-up through the live production browser and PostgreSQL, separate actual-model typed working-plan eligibility, and production unavailable-model recovery. Role-native proposal probes use committed synthetic records; canonical ProjectThread/InteractionRun, durable proposal decisions/commands, native examiners and connected cycles remain separate required A1 work and are not claimed complete.

review.perspective: Challenge deployed eligibility, role authority, field/reference invention and actual unavailable-model input recovery. Confirm a new document on reload, and serialize mutable tests that share a Project.
